data.name: Krishna Agrawal
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Krishna Agrawal has made a big mark in cricket. With 65 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 71*, with an average of 18.77 and a quick strike rate of 143.93. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 50 sixes and 68 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 59.5 overs, taking 30 wickets at an economy rate of 8.81. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
